note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the French Pacific (prices at 1 April 2026), New Caledonia's table: the yearly price, in CFP francs, of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The OPT, the post office's bank, offers none. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept.
